subject: design/feature-implementation-drive
statement: `candidate-evidence/v1` is immutable per candidate and scenario-set fingerprint. Its closed identity is `{feature, F, M, C, tree, builder_version, merge_policy_version, scenario_set_fingerprint}`; each required scenario result adds `{scenario_id, route, runner_identity, actor_identity, started_at, completed_at, outcome, evidence_ref}`. Outcomes are closed: `passed`, `failed`, `manual-accepted`, `manual-rejected`, `pending`, `skipped`, `unavailable`, `inconclusive`. Only `passed` and `manual-accepted` are accepted.
